intro.text: A Malwish machine that disables a Sleepless with an interference cloud, which also disrupts many other systems.
A device made by Malwish scholars to guard an area against the Sleepless. Its interference cloud makes a Sleepless's consciousness come apart without directly harming it.

description.text: The cloud has other effects too: it stops a dragon from reaching others of its kind and interferes with many systems, including faster-than-light communication. The machine is usually shaped like a big bulb, with disks set into its front.
The effect lasts only while the cloud is on: once it is switched off, a Sleepless can gather its consciousness again. It works somewhat like an Aviar's mind-shield, but is far stronger.

items.text: When the Malwish learned a Sleepless was on their island, they switched one on and Chrysalis was knocked out. Her crewmates realized it was an interference cloud, which would also disrupt their own systems and stop her recovering.
